source.original_question:
What fraction of the area of the figure is shaded?
Choices:
A.3/8
B.1/4
C.1/8
D.1/10
E.1/16

adaptations.reason: Original answer relies on unmarked trisections; added explicit equal-part marks and wording so the fraction is rigorously determined without guessing from pixel lengths.

independent_solution.method: Each shaded triangle has base one third of the rectangle width and height one half of its height, hence area=(1/2)*(W/3)*(H/2)=WH/12. Three shaded triangles total WH/4, so fraction=1/4.
